MATCH path = (t0:Tdoc)-[:REVISED_TO|IS_REVISION_OF*1..8]-(t:Tdoc) WHERE t0.tdocNumber = 'R4-2300771' AND t <> t0 AND all(i IN range(0, length(path) - 1) WHERE (type(relationships(path)[i]) = 'REVISED_TO' AND startNode(relationships(path)[i]) = nodes(path)[i]) OR (type(relationships(path)[i]) = 'IS_REVISION_OF' AND endNode(relationships(path)[i]) = nodes(path)[i])) WITH DISTINCT t MATCH (t)<-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]-(d:DecisionDisposition) WHERE (toLower(coalesce(d.evidenceStatus, '')) CONTAINS 'verified' OR toLower(coalesce(d.evidenceStatus, '')) CONTAINS 'confirmed') AND NOT toLower(coalesce(d.evidenceStatus, '')) CONTAINS 'unverified' AND NOT toLower(coalesce(d.evidenceStatus, '')) CONTAINS 'unconfirmed' AND NOT toLower(coalesce(d.evidenceStatus, '')) CONTAINS 'not' WITH t, d MATCH (p:CRPack)-[:HAS_CR|BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]-(c) WHERE c.tdocNumber = t.tdocNumber RETURN DISTINCT t.tdocNumber AS final_document, d.dispositionCode AS disposition, p.crPackId AS cr_pack

MATCH (p:CRPack)-[:HAS_CR|BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]-(c) WHERE p.crPackId = 'RP-243073' WITH DISTINCT c.tdocNumber AS doc MATCH (t:Tdoc) WHERE t.tdocNumber = doc MATCH (t)<-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]-(d:DecisionDisposition)-[:DISPOSITION_OF|HAS_DISPOSITION]-(r:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE (toLower(coalesce(d.evidenceStatus, '')) CONTAINS 'verified' OR toLower(coalesce(d.evidenceStatus, '')) CONTAINS 'confirmed') AND NOT toLower(coalesce(d.evidenceStatus, '')) CONTAINS 'unverified' AND NOT toLower(coalesce(d.evidenceStatus, '')) CONTAINS 'unconfirmed' AND NOT toLower(coalesce(d.evidenceStatus, '')) CONTAINS 'not' RETURN DISTINCT t.tdocNumber AS document, d.dispositionCode AS disposition, coalesce(m.meetingNumber, m.canonicalMeetingNumber, m.id) AS wg_meeting
